## Current Setup — SSH Bootstrap

`config.current_ssh` · Form present in source

Enter the RPM user password. The integration validates Savant data before saving the token and SSH refresh key.

| Field | Label | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ssh_password` | RPM User Password | Password for the 'RPM' user account on the Savant host. The integration will validate the token candidate, install a refresh key, and retrieve the Influx read token automatically. |

## Re-provision SSH Key

`options.reprovision_ssh` · Form present in source

Enter the RPM user password to generate a new SSH key, refresh the Influx token, and rediscover the correct Influx organization.

| Field | Label | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ssh_password` | RPM User Password | Password for the 'RPM' user account on the Savant host. A new SSH key will be generated, the latest Influx token will be fetched, and the organization will be rediscovered automatically. |
